'''Beigo''' ('''Baygo''', '''Baigo''', '''Bego''', '''Beko''', '''Béogé''', '''Beygo''') is an [[extinct language|extinct]] [[Daju languages|Daju language]] once spoken in [[Sudan]] by the Baygo people, numbering some 850 in the late twentieth century.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.ethnologue.com/show_language.asp?code=byg|title = Baygo}}</ref> Similar to [[Darfur Daju]], it is classified as part of the Western Daju family of languages.
